text:
maria-g: Heads up — AP routed invoice INV-2024-0903 and there's an unexpected line called `inference_handling_fee` under the Dedicated section. Not in our SOW. Can @vendors-billing confirm what this is?

vendors-billing: Hi Maria — sorry for the confusion. That's a newly itemized cross-region routing fee we started reporting. We should have notified you, my bad.

jonah: We never agreed to a separate routing fee on committed capacity. Our contract only lists 'reserved capacity' and 'burst' rates. Where is the change documented?

vendors-billing: It was included in the May addendum email but I agree we should not have started billing without a heads-up. If you want, we can flag this invoice while we confirm.

maria-g: Please flag. AP asked for clarification before payment. For context, here's the relevant excerpt from the invoice:

```
INV-2024-0903
Line items:
 - dedicated_reserved_commit: $12,000.00
 - burst_overage (region-us-west): $480.00
 - inference_handling_fee: $120.00
 - cross_region_failover_adj: $0.00
 Total: $12,600.00
```

lia-accounting: Putting INV-2024-0903 on hold in the ledger (code: vendor_dispute). AP won't pay until we have vendor confirmation or a credit.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0903 status changed to ON_HOLD by lia-accounting at 2024-09-04T14:12:00Z.

sam-finance: @vendors-billing, can you share the usage window and the rule that triggered the `inference_handling_fee`? We need a reproducible calc to match our internal meters.

vendors-billing: Sure — our records show a short 3-hour spill from 2024-08-29T03:10Z to 2024-08-29T06:20Z where ~12% of requests were routed to a fallback cluster in eu-west. The fee is $40/hr when fallback routing exceeds 10% of sustained qps.

jonah: That fallback was due to an autoscale hiccup we had in the us-west pool — we didn't expect to be charged for routed traffic during a measured incident. Our expectation per contract: committed capacity covers routing within customer-owned flannel; failover recovery should be handled via SLA credits, not a new line item.

vendors-billing: Understood. Two options: 1) We can issue a one-time credit for the $120 while we update billing docs and notify you going forward, or 2) we can leave the line and provide detailed meter-level CSV for reconciliation. Which do you prefer?

maria-g: Option 1 please. Issue the credit and update the invoice PDF. Also send a short note describing the threshold and when it'll be applied in future invoices. We'll need that for our procurement records.

lia-accounting: Once credit memo is posted we'll remove the ON_HOLD flag and route for payment.

vendors-billing: Credit initiated: CM-2024-0897 for $120. We'll attach the explanatory note and update the next cycle to call out the routing fee separately with threshold language. Apologies again.

sam-finance: Thanks. Sam opened internal ticket #FIN-497 to confirm product/contract escalations so this isn't applied retroactively in other accounts.

maria-g: Perfect. @lia-accounting please confirm when AP sees the credit, then we can close. :thumbsup:

lia-accounting: Will do — tracking CM-2024-0897 now.

vendors-billing: Closing the thread on our side once the credit shows as applied.
